current_decision: Keep Mini ARK as the active implementation/development name. Treat Journey as emerging product/system identity planning until a deliberate release migration is approved.

expression_framework.short_form: HEXSEED is the persistent platform. Journey configures it. Functional kernels define what work exists. Expression profiles define how that work is understood and presented. CareBloomOS is the first mature profile, not the base ontology. All profiles are peer translations of the same underlying job-role architecture.
expression_framework.architecture_rule: Reason from functional kernel to expression profile to profile-specific translation. Do not use Carestone as the base class for every other manifestation.

manifestation_rule.identity_boundary: CareBloom is the expression of the computer experience. Mini ARK/Journey is the connective orchestration layer beneath manifestations. Do not refer to Mini ARK/Journey by a component stone or manifestation alias just because that layer is visually prominent.
manifestation_rule.expression_sync_policy: Mini ARK/Journey's visible interface should harmonize with the active HEXSEED manifestation through color, ornament, iconography, motion, sound, and light flavor language while preserving familiar controls, stable system meaning, and backend identity.
manifestation_rule.stability_requirement: Manifestations should not require the user to relearn the computer.
manifestation_rule.familiar_terms_policy: If a thematic substitution requires remembering a glossary, translating terminology, or stopping to ask what a familiar system location is called, preserve the familiar system term. Flavor can supplement it, not obscure it.
manifestation_rule.manifestation_alias_policy: A manifestation may rename or reskin the surface expression of stones, but those aliases are not backend identity replacements.

carebloom_boundary.functional_kernels: neutral job-role architecture beneath every expression
carebloom_boundary.stones: CareBloom expression of the neutral functional kernels
carebloom_boundary.mini_ark: current implementation of the connective orchestration layer
carebloom_boundary.journey: future identity of the connective orchestration layer

manifestation_rule.decision_test: Does this transformation increase delight without increasing cognitive friction?

architecture_summary: Journey is the adaptive local orchestration layer that continuously reconciles HEXSEED with the user's evolving way of working. Mini ARK is the current implementation name. Project ARK remains the higher-order architecture.
